rival.name: FactorMiner
rival.own_gate: Stage 1 of ValidationPipeline.evaluate_candidate at defaults: |mean RankIC| >= 0.04 and |ICIR| >= 0.5 against the next bar's open-to-close return

gates.cost: net Sharpe > 0 at CostModel.bitget_perp() (12 bps round trip)

conversion: each bar, the twelve scores ranked onto [-1, 1] (ties averaged, missing flat): every instrument's weight is its leg of the factor's long-short book

arms.oriented: flipped where FactorMiner's RankIC on the first 65% of bars is negative
arms.placebo: as_written rotated 50% of the sample against the returns: the all-gates null

fairness: FactorMiner's factors are cross-sectional scores built for wide A-share panels; twelve names is a thin cross-section for them, amount/vwap and 'overnight' mean little on round-the-clock perpetual tokens, and each per-instrument leg carries market exposure the full book would net out. Per-category results are published for that reason.

verdict.reason: no arm, ARGUS's or FactorMiner's, passes every gate above the calibrated noise rate (0.0521). On twelve instruments over 90 days of hourly bars the split-half gate reaches 80% power only at 0.62 directional accuracy, so an edge below that is invisible to every searcher; the comparison cannot separate the libraries, and that is a property of the evidence, not of either searcher

factorminer_factors.name: VWAP Curvature
factorminer_factors.formula: Neg(CsRank(Sub(Div(Sub($vwap, Delay($vwap, 5)), Add(Delay($vwap, 5), 1e-8)), Div(Sub(Delay($vwap, 5), Delay($vwap, 10)), Add(Delay($vwap, 10), 1e-8)))))

factorminer_factors.name: Adaptive Range Reversal
factorminer_factors.formula: IfElse(Greater(Std($returns, 10), Mean(Std($returns, 10), 40)), Neg(CsRank(Div(Sub($close, TsMin($close, 10)), Add(Sub(TsMax($close, 10), TsMin($close, 10)), 1e-8)))), Neg(CsRank(Return($close, 5))))
